verdicts.title: Sharp Bounds on the Eigenvalues of Kikuchi Graphs and Applications to Quantum Max Cut
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We prove that the maximum eigenvalue of the (both signed and unsigned) Laplacian of level $k$ Kikuchi graph of any graph $G$ with $m$ edges is at most $m+k$. This confirms four recent conjectures of Apte, Parekh, and Sud.
